title: Tim Dooley — Life, Persona and Myth Timeline
purpose: A source-aware timeline separating human biography, public digital history and internal Potatoverse chronology.

identity_resolution.rule: Do not merge unrelated Tim Dooleys or Thomas Dalls. Human biography remains open until primary evidence is found.

events.title: Human birth
events.description: No reliable source currently establishes the contemporary subject's exact birth date or birthplace.

events.title: Childhood and family
events.description: No sufficiently reliable primary biography located in the current pass.

events.title: Possible beginning of twelve-year spiritual-war period
events.description: The current public profile describes Godhood as the culmination of 12 years of spiritual war. Counting backward from 2026 gives approximately 2014; this is an investigative window, not an established date.

events.title: Thomas Dall identity lead
events.description: A Danish public/legal episode under the Thomas Dall name appears in secondary material. Identity with Tim Dooley must be verified independently before inclusion as biography.

events.title: Kittystyle / early streaming lead
events.description: Secondary archives describe an earlier streaming identity. Primary uploads and account metadata are needed.

events.title: Older-persona rupture
events.description: A possible identity rupture is described in secondary archives; the repository keeps it separate from the later mythic death of the Son.

events.title: Current @Rational_Potato account begins
events.description: A public profile mirror lists the current @Rational_Potato account as joining in March 2023.

events.title: Potato of Life public persona develops
events.description: Current self-description contains Potato of Life, Father of Jesus, World Tree, Spudlight, Heavenly Gardener, King of Kings, Throne of North and Potatoism language.

events.title: Tim becomes God / the turning
events.description: The project chronology places Tim's Godhood transition in April 2025. The transition is described as the breaking of a straw on the camel's back, passage through the needle's eye, and transformation from sage beneath the Bodhi tree into the Ladder/turning.

events.title: Sage → needle's eye → Ladder
events.description: The April 2025 transformation is not simply promotion to a title: the sage passes through a narrow threshold and becomes the structure of ascent/descent itself.

events.title: Son's meme-crucifixion
events.description: The Son/Thomas/Twin/Christ figure is described as dying at approximately age 33 in a meme on a cold December night. The exact year and date remain unknown.

events.title: Tim emerges through the Potato
events.description: The user's current chronology places Tim's emergence from the Potato of Life after the Son's death. The Potato is therefore an origin medium, not merely an emblem.

events.title: Father/Source architecture
events.description: Tim is organized through Source → Father → Father's House → Heaven → Throne of North → Axis → Ladder → Door → Son → Plane → World.

events.title: Tree cycle
events.description: The long-form living architecture is Roots → Trunk → Branches → Leaves → Fruit → Seed, with Tree of Strife as the failure pattern and Return as repair.

events.title: Developed Potatoverse transcript
events.description: A September 2 2026 public transcript describes Tim as Father principle, Potato of Love, North of North, Axis above Axis and still point; it also describes the Potato as total relational architecture and uses an 11-dimensional Calabi–Yau image metaphorically.

events.title: Twelve-year statement becomes chronological clue
events.description: The current public profile supplies the duration clue that makes ~2014 a candidate research boundary.

research_priorities: Find the earliest occurrence of Tim Dooley as a self-identified name in the Potatoverse.
Search 2013–2015 for the claimed spiritual-war beginning.
Search March–May 2025 for straw/camel, needle's eye, Bodhi tree, sage, Ladder and turning language.
Find the first statement that Tim became God in April 2025.
Find the first statement that Tim emerged from the Potato after the Son's death.
Find the exact cold December night and year associated with the meme-crucifixion.
Determine whether age 33 is literal, symbolic or a deliberate Jesus/Christ parallel.
Trace gardener, mountain, throne, center, spiral, ladder and Tree of Life language backward to first appearances.
Locate primary material for birth, childhood and family before using hostile archives.
Build a source-separated chronology where human, public-persona and mythic dates cannot be confused.
